name: Beef 'Doner' with Cucumber, Tomatoes & Yogurt Sauce

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 lemons
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tomatoes and cucumbers into ¼-inch cubes and transfer to a large salad bowl.
Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the salad bowl with the cucumber and tomatoes to make the salad.
Juice the lemon, add half of the juice to the salad and put the other half aside in a medium bowl.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the salad; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Combine oil, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper, and two thirds of the garlic in an another medium bowl to make the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice the onion; transfer to the marinade bowl with the oil and spices.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the beef dry with paper towels, then cut into 1-inch chunks. Add to the bowl with the marinade; stir until well combined.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add beef mixture. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and beef is cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
To the remaining lemon juice, add yogurt, salt, and one-third of the garlic. Whisk to make the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place pita bread on a plate and top with beef, salad, and yogurt dressing. Enjoy!
